description: This bar chart illustrates the ratio for three large language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball” in that order, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each category, there are three bars representing the ratio for each model; Llama3 is blue, Qwen2 is red, and ChatGPT is yellow. For the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 89%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 91%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 72%. In the “Songs” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 64%. Finally, in the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 62%. The bars are grouped by category, with each model represented by a distinct color within each group. The categories are arranged alphabetically, and no bars are visually emphasized.
